title: globset: match filename-only regexes against basenames
body:
We now match filename-only globs such as `**/.venv*` and `**/*.py[cod]` against the basename, avoiding a regex search over the full path. We use this strategy only when the filename pattern cannot match a path separator.

On Linux x86-64 against `3fce3b5`, building the Python ignore rules is about 23% faster. Warm incremental replay over Ruff paths improves 4–9%; replay over uv paths is flat in the default build and improves 2–4% with fat LTO. The default-build Ruff parallel walk is 3.7% slower.
commits: globset: match filename-only regexes against basenames
